Prepositions of place · 要点精讲(第3轮): Prepositions of place tell where something is: in/on/under/behind/between/next to.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:in + internal; on + surface; between + two objects; behind/under/next to。
in + internal space: in the box|on + surface contact: on the desk|under + lower side, behind + back side|between + two objects (connected by and)|next to / beside = beside

column4: 考查in + internal; on + surface; between + two objects; behind/under/next to。此处应为 under。句意:球在床底下。
